name: Lagertorwiese
beschreibung: The **Lagertorwiese** campsite is located in **Going am Wilden Kaiser** in Tirol. The facility is situated in a quiet, natural setting at the foot of the **Wilder Kaiser** mountain range. Amenities include **sanitary facilities**, **electric hookups**, and a **kitchenette**. Pitches are designed for **motorhomes**, **caravans**, and **tents**. A **small shop** on the grounds offers everyday groceries. In summer, the site serves as a starting point for **hikes** and **climbing tours** in the Kaisergebirge. In winter, the **ski areas** of SkiWelt and Kitzbühel are within reach. The straightforwardly run campsite offers a **practical base** for active holidaymakers.
